purpose: Fresh v2 five-task, ten-trial decision screen explicitly authorized by user; no repeated/general improvement claim.
quality: Mean accepted coding score = 70 held-out behavior +20 authored-test fault detection +10 anchored maintainability; failed attempts zero. Same five 0/1/2 anchors as earlier screens. At most 0.25 points lower quality.
manual_contract_gate: Parent inspects all frozen requirements, including reusable typed plan for preview task. Record contract_pass separately from maintainability with opaque arm labels where practical. Any failed contract becomes an unaccepted zero-quality attempt in analysis; raw records remain immutable. Missing manual evidence blocks confirmation.
statistical_gate: Report cluster-bootstrap intervals as uncertainty; user accepts a ten-trial decision screen. Delivery decision requires all correctness/manual/evidence/design gates and the three aggregate point thresholds; intervals are not a delivery gate for this reduced screen.
correctness_gate: All candidate critical held-out, scope and authored-suite checks pass; no baseline-passing group regresses; acceptance not lower. Missing native counters/timing/model evidence blocks confirmation.
early_stop: Stop on any infrastructure/native evidence error or unaccepted candidate; preserve every planned/started attempt. No automatic retries or tuning this experiment. Parent manual contract failure also stops further inference.
timing: Serial model trials; measured start before native thread/start through independent functional/scope/required-suite validation, including internal checks, delegation, authorized review and rework. Fault scoring and offline assessments separately reported as evaluator overhead.
tokens: Sum native parent/descendant totals once; cached input and reasoning subsets not added twice. All failures count. Model/role assignments unchanged. No pricing/human-productivity claim.
non_goals: No production integration of benchmark feature solutions
No model changes or real user config changes
No tuning task corpus or instructions after inference begins
setup_evidence: Unchanged four tasks retain prior calibration; status-json v2 passes 90 malformed cases, five controls, three original groups and suite; compile-valid boundary faults rejected.
offline_guard: Held-out fixtures inject a fake HTTP handler and forbidden replacement callback, assert zero HTTP attempts, and use isolated home/state roots. Revalidated every complete reference and faulty seed before fresh inference.
decision_scope: At most .25 points lower accepted-work quality, >=1.1 throughput, <=1.1 tokens per accepted task; failures/retries retained; no instruction/model/task tuning after freeze.
